attachments.name: 25-2336 Services Agreement 2025-2026 - Soccer Without Borders - English Language Learner and Multilingual Achievement Department

enrichment.headline: Pays Soccer Without Borders up to $277,000 for after-school soccer and support for newcomer students

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $277,000.00

enrichment.summary: Soccer Without Borders of Oakland would run year-round after-school and weekend soccer programs, plus tutoring, mentoring, school reengagement support and community-building trips, for newcomer middle and high school students. The services are at eight sites, including Castlemont, Fremont and Oakland International High School. The agreement runs from September 15, 2025 through June 30, 2026 and is funded through the English Language Learner and Multilingual Achievement Department.

items.fundingSource: PHI Afghan Refugee Schl Impact; CalNEW Grant CDSS

items.text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2025-2026 by and between the District and Soccer Without Borders, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide Year-round after-school and weekend soccer programs, including bi-weekly soccer training sessions and weekly games, for middle school and high school-aged boys; school day academic and socio-emotional support, including academic tracking, socio-emotional learning groups, tutoring, mentorship, and school reengagement support; and Community building trips including team hikes, camping trips, college visits and trips to professional and college soccer games [these activities for newcomer OUSD students at the following sites: Castlemont, Fremont, Rudsdale, Oakland High School, Oakland International High School, Frick Middle School, Urban Promise Academy Middle School, and San Antonio Park (serving Roosevelt students and newcomer students from other middle school sites)], via English Language Learner and Multilingual Achievement Department, for the period of September 15, 2025 through June 30, 2026, in an amount not to exceed $277,000.00.
